name: Kingstar KKWB18 Wardrobe
description: Elegant 2-door Kingstar wardrobe with full-length mirror and locking door. Made from melamine board. Compact, durable and ideal for bedrooms.
details: The Kingstar KKWB18 is a practical 2-door wardrobe made from melamine board. It features one full-length mirrored door and one solid door with a secure lock. The dark wood finish gives a smart, modern look. Compact size makes it suitable for smaller bedrooms while still offering useful storage space. Strong build quality and easy-to-clean surface make it a reliable choice for Sri Lankan homes.
